I agree with @Amblard's comment that the Goal section should explain what "balanced" means in the context of this clash.

The brackets on the outside are on the wrong order, each bracket should be pointing towards the middle or into another outward bracket, no bracket should point outwards without a inward bracket, therefore, you would need to balance it to {{}{}{}{}}.
